summary: I inspected the complete branch diff, every added product component and asset, the surrounding layout and Vite configuration, and independently compared the protected film files with master. All six acceptance criteria are met; notably, the previously reported narrative opening and ending now match the task’s required wording, and the recorded typecheck and build both exited successfully.

criteria.evidence: src/App.tsx:20-27 orders Header, the Film-containing hero and track, ProductPage, then SiteFooter. src/product/ProductPage.tsx:13-19 orders Gallery, BuyBlock, Notes, and Narrative; src/product/Gallery.tsx:10-35 references all four gallery PNGs; src/product/Header.tsx:1 and src/product/SiteFooter.tsx:1-2 reference the downloaded logo and payment assets. Direct inspection confirmed all six asset files contain the corresponding product/logo/payment imagery.

`git diff --exit-code master...HEAD -- src/film/Film.tsx src/scroll/ScrollProvider.tsx` produced no diff. Independent SHA-256 comparisons matched master exactly for Film.tsx (1da899f1ee4171ebc204d396cf3671b22ce91c190f9ed47bd0b614ce6339a2d7) and ScrollProvider.tsx (4c8bb6ee04de0949c4c71b7cb3a685430b010a3d2e278e4248301c08d09b53af); src/styles.css:32-35 makes the stage sticky and src/styles.css:103-112 preserves the track-based layout.

src/product/BuyBlock.tsx:11-14 contains the exact 100ml and 50ml prices; lines 39-59 render the selected price and size controls. src/product/Notes.tsx:8-30 contains the required top, heart, and base note lists. src/product/Narrative.tsx:9-12 contains the required narrative from the exact specified opening through the exact specified ending; this verifies the prior finding was corrected.

index.html:11-15 loads Tenor Sans. src/styles.css:218-225 defines #111111 page ink and a Tenor Sans display stack with serif fallbacks; lines 292-309 apply it to the product and headings, while lines 312-320 and 512-518 provide generous section spacing. src/product/BuyBlock.tsx:61-69 provides explicit “Selling out quick” and stock text rather than color-only status.

src/product/BuyBlock.tsx:23-31 keeps variant and added state locally; lines 39-59 reflect variant selection in the displayed price and lines 71-77 implement a local-only add confirmation. A search of src and index.html found no fetch, XMLHttpRequest, Axios, sendBeacon, WebSocket, API, or checkout request, and vite.config.ts:4-11 remains a static client build.
Recorded verification output shows `npm run typecheck` exited 0, followed by `npm run build` exiting 0 after TypeScript and Vite completed successfully with 43 modules transformed.
